thesis: Symmetry constrains a theory only through specified transformations and conditions.
role: Show unification and the distinction among laws, states and observed invariance.

ideas.statement: Noether connects continuous symmetries and conservation under precise assumptions; local and global claims cannot be freely exchanged.
Symmetric rules can yield asymmetric states; observed invariance may reflect insensitive instruments rather than reality.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Elegance merits confidence only through testable consequences.
